global.title: Kalmar Ottawa electric yard truck gets to work in Canada
global.summary: Kalmar Ottawa has been a leader in diesel-powered yard trucks for decades, but as global logistics fleets move to reduce costs and insulate themselves from volatile diesel prices, the company is making that shift, too – and they’re out to prove their new, battery-electric T2 EV can deliver the same

global.title: Met police break their own record for seizing illegal e-bikes
global.summary: London’s Metropolitan Police have already confiscated more illegal e-bikes and e-scooters in 2026 than during the entirety of last year, as authorities continue an aggressive enforcement campaign targeting illegally modified micromobility vehicles.

global.title: Another day at the office: Fortescue CEO test drives 150 ton haul truck [video]
global.summary: Industrial mining giants Fortescue have been leading the charge towards electrifying every aspect of their operations – and last week, the company’s CEO took some time to actually get out and test drive some of the company’s newest battery-powered heavy machines.

global.title: Windrose says 10 of its electric semi trucks are coming to Texas’ I-35 corridor
global.summary: The electric semi truck market seems to be heating up in Texas, with Wen Han’s upstart Windrose brand set to deploy 10 fully electric Class 8 trucks on the I-35 freight corridor between Dallas and Laredo en route to Mexico (but there are some caveats).

global.title: E-quipment highlight: Avant Tecno e727 electric wheel loader
global.summary: Increasingly volatile fuel prices are making electric equipment options a need, rather than a want for many fleets, and Avant Tecno is working to meet that need with the new e727 electric wheel loader – the company’s largest offering in North America.

global.title: Waymo crashes 1/3 as much as a human driver, says IIHS – with some caveats
global.summary: Waymo’s autonomous electric taxis crash 68% less than the average human driver, according to the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, with lower-severity crashes on average as well. But there are some important caveats that limit the data.

global.title: Land Rover’s fancy Freelander 8 EREV reveals high-tech, ultra-luxe interior
global.summary: The best seat in Jaguar Land Rover’s newest SUV might not be the one behind the steering wheel! New interior images of the Freelander 8 EREV revealed on Chinese social media show a six-seat, ultra-luxury luxury cabin that looks less “seats six,” and more G6.

global.title: Europe’s next-generation submarines are getting a lithium-ion battery upgrade
global.summary: European defense contractor Saft is set to supply lithium-ion battery systems for the next generation of naval submarines, replacing decades-old lead-acid technology with EV-style packs that promise higher energy density, faster charging, and superior underwater endurance.

global.title: Another state may legalize electric motorbikes up to 30 and 40 mph under sweeping new micromobility bill
global.summary: Massachusetts lawmakers are considering a new statewide framework for micromobility that could finally bring clearer rules to everything from e-bikes and e-scooters to higher-speed electric motorbikes capable of reaching 30 mph, 40 mph, and beyond.

global.title: Musk says Tesla to ‘open source’ Model S and X, but prior release makes us skeptical
global.summary: Elon Musk says Tesla plans to “open source” the Model S and Model X, and he’s pointing to the original Roadster as the template. The problem is Tesla’s Roadster release amounted to eight files on GitHub plus five document packages behind a login, with no open-source license attached to any of it.
